# EmptyState

What a surface shows when there is nothing to show — a line of prose in the display face and a quiet mono note under it.

## Anatomy

Centred: the serif italic title, an optional mono hint, and an optional action.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` *(required)* | `string` | — | The serif italic line the reference uses — "The booth is quiet." |
| `hint` | `string` | — | The mono micro-label under it — "Connectors will speak up here". |
| `action` | `Snippet` | — | — |

## Variants

None.

## States

Static.

## Keyboard

Not interactive, apart from an action passed in.

## ARIA

None of its own. When the emptiness is the result of a search or a filter, the surface should announce it through a live region rather than relying on this appearing.

## Accessibility acceptance criteria

- Reachable, operable and leavable by keyboard alone, with a focus indicator meeting 3:1 in both schemes.
- An accessible name for every control, and current state exposed programmatically.
- No meaning carried by colour alone.
- Legible and operable at a 360px viewport and at desktop width, and at 200% zoom.
- Interactive targets at least 44 × 44px on touch-capable viewports.
